title: Machine Minds
summary: Unity tank shooter with machine-learning–driven adaptive difficulty (capstone project).
description: Machine Minds is a level-based 2D tank shooter built in Unity that experiments with machine-learning–powered adaptive difficulty. The game collects gameplay metrics (accuracy, damage taken, survival time, score progression) and player survey feedback between levels, then uses a supervised learning model (logistic regression in Python via scikit-learn) to adjust difficulty by ~20% per level. It supports PC (Windows/macOS) and WebGL, includes Firebase-backed leaderboards, and uses a REST API for Python–Unity communication on non-WebGL platforms.
